name: gated-build
description: harness implement -> shell pytest -> shell gate emitting Verdict (a fully deterministic gate) -> harness report. Machine checks before model judgment; explicit heal scope; safe self-healing.

spec.task:
Implement the following in this repository:
{args.task}
spec.writes_rationale: generic implementer; the files to change are named by --arg task at run time

cmd: import json,subprocess; p=subprocess.run(['python','-m','pytest','-q'],capture_output=True,text=True); tail=[l for l in (p.stdout+p.stderr).splitlines() if l.strip()][-1:] or ['no output']; print(json.dumps({'command':'pytest -q','exit_code':p.returncode,'summary':tail[0]}))

import json; ec={steps.test.json.exit_code}; s={steps.test.json.summary}; print(json.dumps({'findings': [] if ec==0 else [{'severity':'blocker','category':'tests','file':'','claim':'test suite failed','evidence':s}], 'verdict': 'pass' if ec==0 else 'block', 'reason': 'tests green' if ec==0 else 'pytest exit '+str(ec)}))

spec.task: Summarize what was implemented and the test outcome in five bullet points.
